description: São Tomé and Príncipe - Multi-Tier Framework (MTF) Survey is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Extractive industries", published or maintained by Marina Brutinel; Yuhan Wang; Bryan Bonsuk Koo; Elisa Portale; Dana Rysankova (World Bank Group). The MTF survey is a global baseline survey on household access to electricity and clean cooking, which goes beyond the binary approach to look at access as a spectrum of service levels experienced by households. Resources included are raw data, codebook, questionnaires, sampling strategy document, and country diagnostic report. Coverage: Sao Tome and Principe. It has 5 files in Other, PDF, XLSX. The portal files it under Extractive industries. The portal gives 2019 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
